title: Decoherence, Perturbations and Symmetry in Lindblad Dynamics -- Implications for Diffractive Dissociation
summary: We extend a perturbative Dyson-type treatment and discrete-symmetry constraints from the Schrödinger and von Neumann equations to a dephasing Lindblad framework. This work develops further the odd-symmetric formulation involving dual temporal conditions from general dynamical considerations to specific tools of quantum mechanics.
